name: Kaya
source:
She is the sword-wielding oni who stole the sealed《Sword》from the Suten Group of the Onikiribe (Demon Extermination Organization), and is currently headed to a place where she has a strong karmic bond.
[From [url=http://www.solelo.com/aoishiro/pc/characters.htm]Solelo website[/url]]

[spoiler]In fact, she is Shouko's mother's cousin, Kaya Narumi, who Shouko respects a lot. She was killed while trying to save her and resurrected as oni[spoiler]
